name: Awara (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Awara city emblem in green and yellow: a green stylised leaf-like device enclosing a yellow oval.
history: Municipal flag of Awara, a city in Fukui Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 March 2004.

features.role: Awara city emblem — a green stylised leaf-like device enclosing a yellow oval
